content.snl: %The default bvar-scope highlighting strategy. Hovering over a bvar also highlights sibling bvar nodes with the same bindRef and the binder declaration. This is not a primitive constant; it is an object implementing SnlHighlightStrategy.%
content.markdown: The default `bvar`-scope highlighting strategy. Hovering over a `bvar` also highlights sibling `bvar` nodes with the same `bindRef` and the binder declaration. This is not a primitive constant; it is an object implementing `SnlHighlightStrategy`.
